name: Acute Febrile Respiratory Syndrome Derivation
readable_text: IF fever_present AND cough_present AND fatigue_present THEN acute_febrile_respiratory_syndrome_supported
explanation: Fever, cough, and systemic fatigue together establish an acute febrile respiratory syndromic presentation.

name: Influenza-Like Illness from Febrile Syndrome and Myalgia
readable_text: IF acute_febrile_respiratory_syndrome_supported AND body_aches_present THEN influenza_like_illness_supported
explanation: Acute febrile respiratory syndrome combined with prominent body aches (myalgia) satisfies the core clinical case definition for an influenza-like illness pattern.

name: Severe Influenza-Like Illness Escalation
readable_text: IF influenza_like_illness_supported AND high_fever_present AND chills_present THEN severe_influenza_like_pattern_supported
explanation: An established influenza-like illness presentation accompanied by high fever (>= 39 C) and shaking chills indicates a high constitutional burden.

name: Influenza-Like Illness via Rapid Onset and Shivering/Aches
readable_text: IF acute_febrile_respiratory_syndrome_supported AND rapid_onset_present AND (chills_present OR body_aches_present) THEN influenza_like_illness_supported
explanation: An abrupt symptom onset combined with febrile respiratory features and either chills or body aches provides strong alternative support for influenza-like illness.

name: Nasopharyngeal Catarrhal Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF nasal_congestion_present AND sore_throat_present THEN nasopharyngeal_catarrh_supported
explanation: The co-occurrence of nasal congestion and sore throat establishes mucosal inflammation of the upper nasopharyngeal tract.

name: Common Cold Pattern from Catarrh and Airway Reflexes
readable_text: IF nasopharyngeal_catarrh_supported AND (cough_present OR sneezing_present) THEN common_cold_like_illness_supported
explanation: Nasopharyngeal mucosal inflammation coupled with airway clearing reflexes (cough or sneezing) supports a common cold pattern.

name: Common Cold Pattern via Rhinorrhea and Sore Throat
readable_text: IF sore_throat_present AND clear_rhinorrhea_present AND fatigue_present THEN common_cold_like_illness_supported
explanation: Mild upper respiratory triad of pharyngeal pain, clear nasal discharge, and mild fatigue supports a self-limiting viral common cold pattern.

name: Allergic Rhinopathy Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF sneezing_present AND clear_rhinorrhea_present THEN allergic_rhinopathy_cluster_supported
explanation: The co-occurrence of paroxysmal sneezing and thin watery rhinorrhea suggests hyperreactive nasal mucosal discharge.

name: Allergic Rhinitis Pattern from Rhinopathy and Pruritus
readable_text: IF allergic_rhinopathy_cluster_supported AND (itchy_eyes_present OR itchy_nose_or_palate_present) THEN allergic_rhinitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Nasal discharge accompanied by pruritus of the eyes or palate strongly indicates an IgE-mediated allergic rhinitis pattern.

name: Allergic Rhinitis Pattern via Documented Trigger
readable_text: IF allergen_exposure_trigger_present AND (clear_rhinorrhea_present OR sneezing_present) AND itchy_eyes_present THEN allergic_rhinitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Symptom exacerbation following known allergen exposure with ocular pruritus and nasal symptoms establishes allergic rhinitis.

name: Vascular Migrainous Pain Pattern Derivation
readable_text: IF headache_present AND unilateral_throbbing_headache_present THEN vascular_migrainous_pain_pattern_supported
explanation: Unilateral pulsating headache quality satisfies primary pain morphology for migrainous neurovascular cephalalgia.

name: Migraine Pattern from Pain and Sensory/Autonomic Features
readable_text: IF vascular_migrainous_pain_pattern_supported AND (photophobia_present OR phonophobia_present OR nausea_present) THEN migraine_like_headache_pattern_supported
explanation: Pulsating unilateral pain combined with light/sound sensitivity or nausea meets core clinical criteria for migraine-like headache.

name: Migraine Pattern with Visual Aura
readable_text: IF unilateral_throbbing_headache_present AND visual_aura_present THEN migraine_like_headache_pattern_supported
explanation: A pulsating unilateral headache preceded or accompanied by visual aura pathognomonically supports migraine with aura.

name: Migraine Pattern Aggravated by Activity
readable_text: IF vascular_migrainous_pain_pattern_supported AND worsened_by_routine_activity_present AND (nausea_present OR photophobia_present) THEN migraine_like_headache_pattern_supported
explanation: Aggravation by routine physical activity combined with autonomic/photophobic features supports migraine diagnosis.

name: Acute Enteric Irritation Derivation
readable_text: IF watery_diarrhea_present AND nausea_present THEN acute_enteric_irritation_supported
explanation: Concurrent watery diarrhea and nausea demonstrate acute mucosal irritation of the gastrointestinal tract.

name: Gastroenteritis Pattern from Enteric Irritation and Vomiting/Cramps
readable_text: IF acute_enteric_irritation_supported AND (vomiting_present OR abdominal_cramps_present) THEN acute_gastroenteritis_pattern_supported
explanation: Enteric irritation coupled with emesis or colicky abdominal spasms supports an acute gastroenteritis pattern.

name: Gastroenteritis Pattern via Emesis, Cramps and Fever
readable_text: IF vomiting_present AND abdominal_cramps_present AND fever_present THEN acute_gastroenteritis_pattern_supported
explanation: Febrile presentation accompanied by prominent vomiting and abdominal cramps supports infectious gastroenteritis.

name: Lower Urinary Irritation Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF dysuria_present AND urinary_frequency_present THEN lower_urinary_irritation_cluster_supported
explanation: Dysuria occurring together with urinary frequency establishes bladder and urethral mucosal irritative syndrome.

name: Lower Urinary Tract Infection (Cystitis) Pattern
readable_text: IF lower_urinary_irritation_cluster_supported AND (urinary_urgency_present OR suprapubic_tenderness_present) THEN lower_urinary_tract_infection_pattern_supported
explanation: Lower urinary irritative cluster plus urgency or suprapubic ache supports uncomplicated cystitis (lower UTI).

name: Complicated Upper UTI / Pyelonephritis Escalation
readable_text: IF lower_urinary_tract_infection_pattern_supported AND flank_pain_present AND fever_present THEN complicated_upper_uti_pattern_supported
explanation: Lower urinary tract signs progressing to costovertebral flank pain and systemic fever indicates ascending upper urinary tract infection.

name: Upper UTI Pattern via Direct Flank Pain, Dysuria, and High Fever
readable_text: IF dysuria_present AND flank_pain_present AND high_fever_present THEN complicated_upper_uti_pattern_supported
explanation: Direct co-manifestation of painful urination, unilateral flank pain, and high fever supports suspected acute pyelonephritis.

name: COVID-19 Pattern via Sensory Deficit and Respiratory Triad
readable_text: IF loss_of_taste_or_smell_present AND (cough_present OR fever_present) THEN covid_19_pattern_supported
explanation: Acute loss of taste or smell (anosmia/ageusia) coupled with acute respiratory manifestations (cough or fever) provides pathognomonic evidence for COVID-19 infection.

name: COVID-19 Pattern via Febrile Syndrome and Anosmia
readable_text: IF acute_febrile_respiratory_syndrome_supported AND loss_of_taste_or_smell_present THEN covid_19_pattern_supported
explanation: An established acute febrile respiratory syndrome accompanied by new onset anosmia confirms a COVID-19 clinical pattern.

name: Streptococcal Pharyngitis Syndrome Derivation (Centor Criteria)
readable_text: IF sore_throat_present AND fever_present AND (tonsillar_exudate_present OR tender_cervical_nodes_present) THEN strep_throat_syndrome_supported
explanation: Co-occurrence of pharyngeal pain, fever, and tonsillar exudate or cervical lymphadenopathy satisfies modified Centor clinical criteria for streptococcal pharyngitis.

name: Streptococcal Pharyngitis Confirmation
readable_text: IF strep_throat_syndrome_supported AND tonsillar_exudate_present THEN strep_throat_pattern_supported
explanation: Established febrile pharyngeal syndrome combined with visible tonsillar exudate strongly supports acute bacterial streptococcal pharyngitis.

name: Sinus Obstruction Syndrome Derivation
readable_text: IF nasal_congestion_present AND facial_pressure_present THEN sinus_obstruction_syndrome_supported
explanation: Nasal congestion coupled with localized facial pain or fullness over the cheeks/forehead indicates paranasal sinus ostium blockage.

name: Acute Rhinosinusitis Pattern from Obstruction and Purulent Secretions
readable_text: IF sinus_obstruction_syndrome_supported AND purulent_nasal_discharge_present THEN acute_sinusitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Paranasal sinus blockage with thick, purulent (yellow/green) nasal drainage fulfills standard guidelines for acute rhinosinusitis.

name: Acute Rhinosinusitis via Facial Pressure and Headache
readable_text: IF facial_pressure_present AND purulent_nasal_discharge_present AND headache_present THEN acute_sinusitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Facial tenderness accompanied by purulent rhinorrhea and secondary cranial headache establishes acute rhinosinusitis.

name: Lower Airway Sputum Secretion Derivation
readable_text: IF cough_present AND productive_cough_present THEN lower_airway_hypersecretion_supported
explanation: Frequent cough productive of noticeable phlegm demonstrates tracheobronchial mucosal hypersecretion.

name: Acute Bronchitis Pattern
readable_text: IF lower_airway_hypersecretion_supported AND fatigue_present THEN acute_bronchitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Productive lower airway cough coupled with constitutional fatigue supports self-limited acute bronchitis.

name: Bronchospastic Airway Syndrome Derivation
readable_text: IF wheezing_present AND cough_present THEN bronchospastic_syndrome_supported
explanation: Co-occurrence of expiratory musical wheezing and irritative cough establishes lower airway bronchoconstriction.

name: Asthma / Bronchospasm Exacerbation Pattern
readable_text: IF bronchospastic_syndrome_supported AND (allergen_exposure_trigger_present OR rapid_onset_present) THEN asthma_bronchospasm_pattern_supported
explanation: Bronchospastic airway symptoms triggered by allergens or exhibiting rapid onset fulfill clinical criteria for an asthma / reactive airway exacerbation.

name: Pericranial Muscle Tension Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF bilateral_band_like_headache_present AND neck_muscle_tension_present THEN pericranial_tension_cluster_supported
explanation: Bilateral band-like pressure accompanied by cervical muscle stiffness reflects heightened pericranial myofascial tension.

name: Tension-Type Headache Pattern
readable_text: IF pericranial_tension_cluster_supported AND headache_present THEN tension_type_headache_pattern_supported
explanation: General cranial ache combined with verified pericranial band-like tension confirms standard ICHD-3 tension-type headache.

name: Acid Peptic Reflux Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF heartburn_reflux_present AND acid_regurgitation_present THEN acid_peptic_reflux_cluster_supported
explanation: Retrosternal pyrosis (heartburn) together with acidic fluid regurgitation defines the classical symptom constellation of gastric acid reflux.

name: Gastroesophageal Reflux Disease (GERD) Pattern
readable_text: IF acid_peptic_reflux_cluster_supported AND symptoms_worse_lying_down_present THEN gerd_reflux_pattern_supported
explanation: Acid reflux cluster with characteristic aggravation in the supine or postprandial state fulfills diagnostic criteria for GERD.

name: Otic Inflammatory Syndrome Derivation
readable_text: IF ear_pain_present AND ear_fullness_present THEN otic_inflammatory_syndrome_supported
explanation: Sharp or aching ear pain accompanied by ear fullness or diminished sound conduction reflects middle ear pressure and effusion.

name: Acute Otitis Media Pattern
readable_text: IF otic_inflammatory_syndrome_supported AND (fever_present OR nasal_congestion_present) THEN acute_otitis_media_pattern_supported
explanation: Middle ear pain and fullness following upper airway viral congestion or accompanied by fever confirms acute otitis media.

name: Allergic Ocular Cluster Derivation
readable_text: IF itchy_eyes_present AND conjunctival_redness_present THEN allergic_ocular_cluster_supported
explanation: Prominent ocular pruritus accompanied by conjunctival hyperemic injection reflects IgE mast cell degranulation on the ocular surface.

name: Acute Allergic Conjunctivitis Pattern
readable_text: IF allergic_ocular_cluster_supported AND (allergen_exposure_trigger_present OR clear_rhinorrhea_present) THEN allergic_conjunctivitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Bilateral ocular redness and itching associated with documented environmental trigger or rhinorrhea establishes allergic conjunctivitis.

name: Invasive Colonic Syndrome Derivation
readable_text: IF bloody_stool_present AND abdominal_cramps_present THEN invasive_colonic_syndrome_supported
explanation: Visible blood in stool associated with severe abdominal cramping indicates mucosal ulceration and invasive colonic inflammation.

name: Acute Invasive Enteritis (Dysentery) Pattern
readable_text: IF invasive_colonic_syndrome_supported AND (fever_present OR high_fever_present) THEN acute_invasive_enteritis_pattern_supported
explanation: Bloody diarrhea accompanied by severe cramps and fever confirms suspected acute invasive bacterial or amoebic dysentery.

name: Common Cold Pattern via Sore Throat and Nasal Congestion
readable_text: IF sore_throat_present AND nasal_congestion_present AND (clear_rhinorrhea_present OR sneezing_present) THEN common_cold_like_illness_supported
explanation: Concurrent sore throat, nasal obstruction, and watery rhinorrhea or sneezing provides strong alternative support for viral common cold.

name: Acute Gastroenteritis Flexible Colic Variant
readable_text: IF watery_diarrhea_present AND abdominal_cramps_present AND (nausea_present OR vomiting_present) THEN acute_gastroenteritis_pattern_supported
explanation: Watery stools accompanied by abdominal colic and upper gastrointestinal distress confirms acute gastroenteritis.

name: Migraine Sensory Triad Variant
readable_text: IF headache_present AND unilateral_throbbing_headache_present AND photophobia_present AND phonophobia_present THEN migraine_like_headache_pattern_supported
explanation: Unilateral pulsating headache associated with dual sensory hypersensitivity (photophobia and phonophobia) definitively supports migraine.

name: GERD Postural Confirmation Variant
readable_text: IF heartburn_reflux_present AND symptoms_worse_lying_down_present THEN gerd_reflux_pattern_supported
explanation: Heartburn exhibiting marked postural exacerbation when lying flat directly supports gastroesophageal reflux disease.

name: Streptococcal Pharyngitis via Cervical Adenopathy
readable_text: IF sore_throat_present AND tender_cervical_nodes_present AND fever_present THEN strep_throat_pattern_supported
explanation: Febrile pharyngitis presenting with tender anterior cervical lymphadenitis strongly supports acute streptococcal pharyngitis.

name: Acute Bronchitis Febrile Variant
readable_text: IF productive_cough_present AND cough_present AND (fever_present OR chills_present) THEN acute_bronchitis_pattern_supported
explanation: Cough productive of phlegm combined with low-grade fever or chills supports lower tracheobronchial bronchitis.
